_comment: Photos on /agency-fam-trip-2027/. To swap a photo, drop <name>.webp (about 1200 px wide) and <name>-640.webp into assets/img/ (or assets/img/showcase/), point 'src' at the path without the extension, update alt/caption/width/height, then run: python3 tools/fam_trip_build.py. Keep every image different (no repeats) and describe only what the photo shows. These are photos of previous projects, not of the proposed programme venues; do not name hotels as part of the programme.
